description: Adds DeepSeek Harness platform support and fixes task session tracking
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- `trellis init --dsh` sets up DeepSeek Harness with shared workflow skills in `.agents/skills/`, entry skills in `.dsh/skills/`, and a guide at `.dsh/DSH.md`.

**Bug Fixes:**
- Active tasks on DeepSeek Harness no longer link to Codex sessions by mistake when `CODEX_THREAD_ID` is present; Trellis now checks `DSH_SESSION_ID` first.
notes: No file migrations required. Backfilled: 0.6.15 shipped on npm without this manifest; it first ships inside 0.6.16.
